1.1: Chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu, en terumatan teruma. hacheresh, vehashshote, vehakkatan, vehattorem et sheeno shello. nachri shettaram et shel yisrael, afillu virshut, en terumato teruma:
1.2: Cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea, lo yitrom. veim taram, terumato teruma. cheresh sheddibberu vo chachamim bechol makom, sheeno lo shomea velo medabber:
1.3: Katan shello hevi shete searot, rabbi yehuda omer, terumato teruma. rabbi yose omer, im ad shello va leonat nedarim, en terumato teruma. umishebba leonat nedarim, terumato teruma:
1.4: En tormin zetim al hashshemen, velo anavim al hayyayin. veim tarmu, bet shammay omrim, terumat atzman bahem. uvet hillel omrim, en terumatan teruma:
1.5: En tormin min halleket, umin hashshichcha, umin happea, umin hahefker, velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato, velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, velo min hachayyav al happatur, velo min happatur al hachayyav, velo min hattalush al hamechubbar, velo min hamechubbar al hattalush, velo min hechadash al hayyashan, velo min hayyashan al hechadash, velo mipperot haaretz al perot chutza laaretz, velo mipperot chutza laaretz al perot haaretz. veim tarmu, en terumatan teruma:
1.6: Chamishsha lo yitromu, veim tarmu, terumatan teruma. haillem, vehashshikkor, vehearom, vehassuma, uvaal keri. lo yitromu, veim tarmu, terumatan teruma:
1.7: En tormin, lo vemidda, velo vemishkal, velo veminyan. aval torem hu et hammadud veet hashshakul veet hammanuy. en tormin besal uvekuppa shehem shel midda, aval torem hu vahen chetzyan ushelishan. lo yitrom bisa chetzyah, shechetzyah midda:
1.8: En tormin shemen al zetim hannichtashin, velo yayin al anavim hannidrachim. veim taram, terumato teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. harishona medammaat bifne atzmah, vechayyavin aleha chomesh, aval lo sheniyya:
1.9: Vetormin shemen al zetim hannichbashim, veyayin al anavim laasotam tzimmukim. hare shettaram shemen al zetim laachila, vezetim al zetim laachila, veyayin al anavim laachila, vaanavim al anavim laachila, venimlach ledarchan, eno tzarich litrom:
1.10: En tormin middavar shennigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto, velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shennigmera melachto, velo middavar shello nigmera melachto al davar shello nigmera melachto. veim tarmu, terumatan teruma:

2.1: En tormin mittahor al hattame. veim tarmu, terumatan teruma. beemet amru, haiggul shel devela shennitma miktzato, torem min hattahor sheyyesh bo al hattame sheyyesh bo. vechen agudda shel yarak, vechen arema. hayu shene iggulim, shete aguddot, shete aremot, achat temea veachat tehora, lo yitrom mizze al ze. rabbi eliezer omer, tormin min hattahor al hattame:
2.2: En tormin min hattame al hattahor. veim taram, shogeg, terumato teruma, umezid, lo asa chelum. vechen ben levi shehaya lo maaser tevel, haya mafrish alav veholech, shogeg, ma sheasa, asuy, mezid, lo asa chelum. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya yodea bo battechilla, af al pi shehu shogeg, lo asa chelum:
2.3: Hammatbil kelim beshabbat, shogeg, yishtammesh bahem, mezid, lo yishtammesh bahem. hameasser vehamevashshel beshabbat, shogeg, yochal, mezid, lo yochal. hannotea beshabbat, shogeg, yekayyem, mezid, yaakor. uvashsheviit, ben shogeg ben mezid, yaakor:
2.4: En tormin mimmin al sheeno mino. veim taram, en terumato teruma. kol min chittim, echad. kol min teenim ugerogarot udevela, echad. vetorem mizze al ze. kol makom sheyyesh kohen, torem min hayyafe. vechol makom sheen kohen, torem min hammitkayyem. rabbi yehuda omer, leolam hu torem min hayyafe:
2.5: Tormin batzal katan shalem, velo chatzi vatzal gadol. rabbi yehuda omer, lo chi, ella chatzi vatzal gadol. vechen haya rabbi yehuda omer, tormin betzalim mibbene hammedina al hakkuferim, aval lo min hakkuferim al bene hammedina, mippene shehu maachal politikin:
2.6: Vetormin zete shemen al zete chevesh, velo zete chevesh al zete shamen. veyayin sheeno mevushshal al hamevushshal, velo min hamevushshal al sheeno mevushshal. ze hakkelal, kol shehu chilayim bachavero, lo yitrom mizze al ze, afillu min hayyafe al hara. vechol sheeno chilayim bachavero, torem min hayyafe al hara, aval lo min hara al hayyafe. veim taram min hara al hayyafe, terumato teruma, chutz min hazzunin al hachittim, sheenan ochel. vehakkishshut vehammelaffon, min echad. rabbi yehuda omer, shene minin:

3.1: Hattorem kishshut venimtzet mara, avattiach venimtza saruach, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. hattorem chavit shel yayin venimtzet shel chometz, im yadua shehayta shel chometz ad shello teramah, ena teruma. im mishshetteramah hechemitza, hare zo teruma. im safek, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom. harishona, enah medammaat bifne atzmah, veen chayyavin aleha chomesh. vechen hashsheniyya:
3.2: Nafla achat mehen letoch hachullin, enah medammatan. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher, enah medammatan. naflu shetehen lemakom echad, medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen:
3.3: Hashshuttafin shettarmu ze achar ze, rabbi akiva omer, terumat shenehem teruma. vachachamim omrim, terumat harishon teruma. rabbi yose omer, im taram harishon kashshiur, en terumat hashsheni teruma. veim lo taram harishon kashshiur, terumat hashsheni teruma:
3.4: Bamme devarim amurim, beshello dibber, aval hirsha et ben beto o et avdo o et shifchato litrom, terumato teruma. bittel, im ad shello taram bittel, en terumato teruma. veim mishshettaram bittel, terumato teruma. happoalim, en lahen reshut litrom, chutz min haddarochot, shehen metammeim et haggat miyyad:
3.5: Haomer, terumat hakkeri ze betocho, umaasrotav betocho, terumat maaser ze betocho, rabbi shimon omer, kara shem. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyomar bitzfono o vidromo. rabbi elazar chisma omer, haomer, terumat hakkeri mimmennu alav, kara shem. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, haomer, issur maaser ze asuy terumat maaser alav, kara shem:
3.6: Hammakdim teruma labbikkurim, maaser rishon latteruma, umaaser sheni larishon, af al pi shehu over belo taase, ma sheasa asuy. shenneemar (Shemot 22), meleatcha vedimacha lo teacher:
3.7: Uminnayin sheyyikdemu habbikkurim latteruma, ze karuy teruma vereshit, veze karuy teruma vereshit, ella yikdemu vikkurim, shehen bikkurim lakkol. uteruma larishon, shehi reshit. umaaser rishon lashsheni, sheyyesh bo reshit:
3.8: Hammitkavven lomar teruma veamar maaser, maaser veamar teruma, ola veamar shelamim, shelamim veamar ola, sheeni nichnas levayit ze veamar laze, sheeni nehene laze veamar laze, lo amar kelum, ad sheyyihyu fiv velibbo shavin:
3.9: Hannachri vehakkuti, terumatan teruma, umaasrotehen maaser, vehekdeshan hekdesh. rabbi yehuda omer, en lannachri kerem revai. vachachamim omrim, yesh lo. terumat hannachri medammaat, vechayyavin aleha chomesh. verabbi shimon poter:

4.1: Hammafrish miktzat teruma umaasrot, motzi mimmennu teruma alav, aval lo lemakom acher. rabbi meir omer, af motzi hu mimmakom acher teruma umaasrot:
4.2: Mi shehayu ferotav bammegura, venatan sea leven levi usea leani, mafrish ad shemone sein veochlan, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, eno mafrish ella lefi cheshbon:
4.3: Shiur teruma, ayin yafa, echad mearbaim. bet shammay omrim, mishsheloshim. vehabbenonit, mechamishshim. veharaa, mishshishshim. taram veala veyado echad mishshishshim, teruma, veeno tzarich litrom. chazar vehosif, chayyav bemaasrot. ala veyado mishshishshim veechad, teruma, veyachazor veyitrom kemot shehu lamud, bemidda uvemishkal uveminyan. rabbi yehuda omer, af shello min hammukkaf:
4.4: Haomer lishlucho, tze uterom, torem kedato shel baal habbayit. im eno yodea dato shel baal habbayit, torem kevenonit, echad mechamishshim. pichet asara o hosif asara, terumato teruma. im nitkavven lehosif afillu achat, en terumato teruma:
4.5: Hammarbe bitruma, rabbi eliezer omer, echad measara, kitrumat maaser, yater mikkan, yaasenna terumat maaser lemakom acher. rabbi yishmael omer, mechetza chullin umechetza teruma. rabbi tarfon verabbi akiva omrim, ad sheyyeshayyer sham chullin:
4.6: Bishlosha ferakim meshaarim et hakkalkala, babbakkurot, uvasseyafot, uveemtza hakkayitz. hammone, meshubbach. vehammoded, meshubbach mimmennu. vehashshokel, meshubbach mishshelashtan:
4.7: Rabbi eliezer omer, teruma, ola beechad umea. rabbi yehoshua omer, bemea vaod. vaod ze, en lo shiur. rabbi yose ben meshullam omer, vaod, kav lemea sea, shetut lammedammea:
4.8: Rabbi yehoshua omer, teenim shechorot maalot et hallevanot, levanot, maalot et hashshechorot. iggule devela, haggedolim maalim et hakketannim, vehakketannim maalin et haggedolim. haiggulim maalin et hammalbenim, vehammalbenim maalin et haiggulim. rabbi eliezer oser. verabbi akiva omer, beyadua ma nafla, en maalot zo et zo, uchesheeno yadua ma nafla, maalot zo et zo:
4.9: Ketzad, chamishshim teenim shechorot vachamishshim levanot, nafla shechora, shechorot asurot vehallevanot muttarot. nafla levana, levanot asurot ushechorot muttarot. besheeno yadua ma nafla, maalot zo et zo. bezo rabbi eliezer machmir, verabbi yehoshua mekel:
4.10: Uvezo rabbi eliezer mekel, verabbi yehoshua machmir. bedores litra ketziot al pi hakkad veeno yodea ezohi, rabbi eliezer omer, roin otan keillu hen perudot, vehattachtonot maalot et haelyonot. rabbi yehoshua omer, lo taale ad sheyyihyu sham mea chaddim:
4.11: Sea teruma shennafla al pi megura vekippeah, rabbi eliezer omer, im yesh bakkippuy mea sea, taale beechad umea, verabbi yehoshua omer, lo taale. sea teruma shennafla al pi megura, yakpienna. veim ken, lamma amru teruma ola beechad umea, im eno yadua im belulot hen, o leayin nafla:
4.12: Shete kuppot ushete megurot shennafla sea teruma letoch achat mehen, veen yadua leezo mehen nafla, maalot zo et zo. rabbi shimon omer, afillu hem bishte ayarot, maalot zo et zo:
4.13: Amar rabbi yose, maase va lifne rabbi akiva bachamishshim aguddot shel yarak, shennafla achat mehen letochan, chetzyah teruma, veamarti lefanav, taale. lo shehatteruma taale bachamishshim veechad, ella shehayu sham mea ushene chatzayim:

5.1: Sea teruma temea shenafla lefachot mimmea chullin, o lemaaser rishon, o lemaaser sheni, o lehekdesh, ben temein ben tehorim, yerakevu. im tehora hayta otah hassea, yimmachru lakkohanim bidme teruma, chutz middeme otah sea. veim lemaaser rishon nafla, yikra shem litrumat maaser. veim lemaaser sheni o lehekdesh nafla, hare ellu yippadu. veim temeim hayu otan hachullin, yeachlu nikkudim o kelayot, o yilloshu veme ferot, o yitchalleku leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:
5.2: Sea teruma temea shennafla letoch mea chullin tehorin, rabbi eliezer omer, terom vetissaref, sheani omer, sea shennafla hi sea shealta. vachachamim omrim, taale veteachel nikkudim o kelayot, o tillosh beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:
5.3: Sea teruma tehora shennafla lemea chullin temein, taale veteachel nikkudim o kelayot, o tillosh beme ferot, o titchallek leissot, kede shello yehe vemakom echad kabbetza:
5.4: Sea teruma temea shennafla lemea sea teruma tehora, bet shammay osrim, uvet hillel mattirin. amru vet hillel levet shammay, hoil utehora asura lezarim utemea asura lechohanim, ma tehora ola, af temea taale. amru lahem bet shammay, lo, im heelu hachullin hakkallin hammuttarin lezarim et hattehora, taale teruma hachamura haasura lezarim et hattemea. leachar shehodu, rabbi eliezer omer, terom vetissaref. vachachamim omrim, avda vemiutah:
5.5: Sea teruma shennafla lemea, higbihah venafla lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer, medammaat kitruma vadday. vachachamim omrim, ena medammaat ella lefi cheshbon:
5.6: Sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea veniddammeu, venafal min hamedumma lemakom acher, rabbi eliezer omer, medammaat kitruma vadday. vachachamim omrim, en hamedumma medammea ella lefi cheshbon, veen hamechummatz machmitz ella lefi cheshbon, veen hammayim sheuvim poslim et hammikve ella lefi cheshbon:
5.7: Sea teruma shennafla lemea, higbihah venafla acheret, higbihah venafla acheret, hare zo mutteret, ad shettirbe teruma al hachullin:
5.8: Sea teruma shennafla lemea, velo hispik lehagebihah ad shennafla acheret, hare zo asura. verabbi shimon mattir:
5.9: Sea teruma shennafla lemea, utechanan ufachatu, keshem sheppachatu hachullin, kach pachata hatteruma, umuttar. sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea, utechanan vehotiru, keshem shehotiru hachullin, kakk hotira hatteruma, veasur. im yadua shehachittim shel chullin yafot mishshel teruma, muttar. sea teruma shennafla lefachot mimmea, veachar ken naflu sham chullin, im shogeg, muttar, veim mezid, asur:

6.1: Haochel teruma shogeg, meshallem keren vechomesh. echad haochel veechad hashshote veechad hassach, echad teruma tehora veechad teruma temea, meshallem chumshah vechomesh chumshah. eno meshallem teruma, ella chullin metukkanim, vehem naasin teruma, vehattashlumin teruma. im ratza hakkohen limchol, eno mochel:
6.2: Bat yisrael sheachla teruma veachar kach nisset lechohen, im teruma shello zacha vah kohen achla, meshallemet keren vechomesh leatzmah. veim teruma shezzacha vah kohen achla, meshallemet keren labbealim, vechomesh leatzmah, mippene sheamru, haochel teruma shogeg, meshallem keren labbealim, vechomesh lechol mi sheyyirtze:
6.3: Hammaachil et poalav veet orchav teruma, hu meshallem et hakkeren, vehem meshallemin et hachomesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, hem meshallemin keren vechomesh, vehu meshallem lahem deme seudatan:
6.4: Haggonev teruma velo achalah, meshallem tashlume chefel deme teruma. achalah, meshallem shene keranim vechomesh, keren vechomesh min hachullin, vekeren deme teruma. ganav terumat hekdesh vaachalah, meshallem shene chomashim vekeren, sheen bahekdesh tashlume chafel:
6.5: En meshallemin min halleket umin hashshichcha umin happea umin hahefker, velo mimmaaser rishon shennittela terumato, velo mimmaaser sheni vehekdesh shennifdu, sheen hekdesh pode et hakkodesh, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim mattirin baellu:
6.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, meshallemin mimmin al sheeno mino, bilvad sheyyeshallem min hayyafe al hara. verabbi akiva omer, en meshallemin ella mimmin al mino. lefichach, im achal kishshuin shel erev sheviit, yamtin lekishshuin shel motzae sheviit, vishallem mehem. mimmekom sherabbi eliezer mekel, mishsham rabbi akiva machmir, shenneemar (Vayikra 22), venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, kol shehu rauy lihyot kodesh, divre rabbi eliezer. verabbi akiva omer, venatan lakkohen et hakkodesh, kodesh sheachol:

7.1: Haochel teruma mezid, meshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh. hattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:
7.2: Bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veachar kach achla teruma, meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh, umitatah bisrefa. nisset leechad mikkol happesulin, meshallemet keren vechomesh, umitatah bechenek, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, zo vazo meshallemot et hakkeren veenan meshallemot et hachomesh, umitatan bisrefa:
7.3: Hammaachil et banav ketannim, veet avadav ben gedolim ben ketannim, haochel terumat chutza laaretz, vehaochel pachot mikkazzayit teruma, meshallem et hakkeren, veeno meshallem et hachomesh. vehattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:
7.4: Ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem keren vechomesh, hattashlumin teruma, im ratza hakkohen limchol, eno mochel. vechol hameshallem et hakkeren veeno meshallem et hachomesh, hattashlumin chullin, im ratza hakkohen limchol, mochel:
7.5: Shete kuppot, achat shel teruma veachat shel chullin, shennafla sea teruma letoch achat mehen veen yadua leezo mehen nafla, hare ani omer, letoch shel teruma nafla. en yadua ezo hi shel teruma veezo hi shel chullin, achal achat mehen, patur, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose potrah. achal acher et hashsheniyya, patur. achal echad et shetehen, meshallem kakketanna shebbishtehen:
7.6: Nafla achat mehen letoch hachullin, enah medammatan, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose poter. nafla sheniyya lemakom acher, enah medammatan. naflu shetehen lemakom echad, medammeot kakketanna shebbishtehen:
7.7: Zara et achat mehen, patur, vehashsheniyya, noheg bah kitruma, vechayyevet bechalla, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose poter. zara acher et hashsheniyya, patur. zara echad et shetehen, bedavar shezzaro chale, muttar, uvedavar sheen zaro chale. asur:

8.1: Haishsha shehayta ochelet bitruma, bau veamru lah, met balich o gershech, vechen haeved shehaya ochel bitruma, uvau veamru lo, met rabbach, o mecharach leyisrael, o netanach bemattana, o asaach ben chorin. vechen kohen shehaya ochel bitruma, venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter. haya omed umakriv al gabbe hammizbeach, venoda shehu ven gerusha o ven chalutza, rabbi eliezer omer, kol hakkarbanot shehikriv al gabbe hammizbeach, pesulim. verabbi yehoshua machshir. noda shehu vaal mum, avodato pesula:
8.2: Vechullam, shehayta teruma vetoch pihem, rabbi eliezer omer, yivleu. verabbi yehoshua omer, yiflotu. amru lo, nitmeta venitmet teruma, rabbi eliezer omer, yivla. verabbi yehoshua omer, yiflot. tame hayita utemea hayta teruma, o noda shehu tevel, umaaser rishon shello nittela terumato, umaaser sheni vehekdesh shello nifdu, o shettaam taam pishpesh letoch piv, hare ze yiflot:
8.3: Haya ochel beeshkol venichnas min hagginna lechatzer, rabbi eliezer omer, yigmor. verabbi yehoshua omer, lo yigmor. chashecha lele shabbat, rabbi yehoshua omer, yigmor. verabbi eliezer omer, lo yigmor:
8.4: Yayin shel teruma shennitgalla, yishshafech, veen tzarich lomar shel chullin. shelosha mashkin asurim mishshum gilluy, hammayim vehayyayin vehechalav. ushear kol hammashkin muttarim. kamma yishhu veyihyu asurin, kede sheyyetze harachash mimmakom karov veyishte:
8.5: Shiur hammayim hamegullin, kede shettovad bahem hammara. rabbi yose omer, bechelim, kol shehen, uvakkarkaot, arbaim sea:
8.6: Nikkure teenim vaanavim vekishshuin vehaddeluin vehaavattichim vehammelaffonot, afillu hem kikkar, echad gadol veechad katan, echad talush veechad mechubbar, kol sheyyesh bo lecha, asur. uneshuchat hannachash, asura, mippene sakkanat nefashot:
8.7: Hameshammeret shel yayin, asura mishshum gilluy. rabbi nechemya mattir:
8.8: Chavit shel teruma shennolad bah sefek tuma, rabbi eliezer omer, im hayta munnachat bimkom turpa, yannichenna bemakom hammutzna, veim hayta megulla, yechassenna. verabbi yehoshua omer, im hayta munnachat bemakom mutzna, yannichenna bimkom turpa, veim hayta mechussa, yegallenna. rabban gamliel omer, al yechaddesh bah davar:
8.9: Chavit shennishbera baggat haelyona, vehattachtona temea, mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, sheim yecholim lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora, yatztzil. veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer, tered vetittamme, veal yetammeenna veyadav:
8.10: Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha, mode rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, sheim yachol lehatztzil mimmenna reviit betohora, yatztzil. veim lav, rabbi eliezer omer, tered vetibbala, veal yevalleenna veyadav:
8.11: Veal zo veal zo amar rabbi yehoshua, lo zo hi teruma sheani muzhar aleha milletammeah, ella milleachlah. uval tetammeah ketzad, haya over mimmakom lemakom vechikkarot shel teruma veyado, amar lo nachri, ten li achat mehen vaatammeah, veim lav, hare ani metamme et kullah, rabbi eliezer omer, yetamme et kullah, veal yitten lo achat mehen vitamme. rabbi yehoshua omer, yanniach lefanav achat mehen al hassala:
8.12: Vechen nashim sheamru lahem nachrim, tenu achat mikkem unetamme, veim lav, hare anu metammeim et kullechem, yetammeu et kullan, veal yimseru lahem nefesh achat miyyisrael:

9.1: Hazzorea teruma, shogeg, yofach. umezid, yekayyem. im hevia shelish, ben shogeg ben mezid, yekayyem. uvefishtan, mezid, yofach:
9.2: Vechayyevet beleket uveshichcha uvefea. vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim, melakketim. vaaniyye yisrael, mochrin et shellahem lakkohanim bidme teruma, vehaddamim shellahem. rabbi tarfon omer, lo yelakketu ella aniyye chohanim, shemma yishkechu veyittenu letoch pihem. amar lo rabbi akiva, im ken, lo yelakketu ella tehorim:
9.3: Vechayyevet bemaasrot uvemaasar ani, vaaniyye yisrael vaaniyye chohanim notlim, vaaniyye yisrael mochrin et shellahem lechohanim bidme teruma, vehaddamim shellahem. hachovet meshubbach. vehaddash ketzad yaase, tole chefifot betzavvere vehema venoten letochan meoto hammin, nimtza lo zomem et habbehema velo maachil et hatteruma:
9.4: Giddule teruma, teruma. vegiddule giddulin, chullin. aval hattevel umaaser rishon usefiche sheviit uterumat chutza laaretz vehamedumma vehabbikkurim, giddulehen, chullin. giddule hekdesh umaaser sheni, chullin, ufode otam bizman zaram:
9.5: Mea ligna shel teruma veachat shel chullin, kullan muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, afillu mea shel chullin veachat shel teruma, kullan asurin:
9.6: Hattevel, giddulav muttarin bedavar shezzaro chale. aval bedavar sheen zaro chale, giddule giddulin, asurin. ezehu davar sheen zaro chale, kegon halluf vehashshum vehabbetzalim. rabbi yehuda omer, hashshum, kasseorim:
9.7: Hamenakkesh im hannachri bachasiyyot, af al pi shepperotav tevel, ochel mehem aray. shetile teruma shenitmeu, shetalan, taharu milletamme, vaasurin milleechol ad sheyyagom et haochel. rabbi yehuda omer ad sheyagom veyishne:

10.1: Batzal shennetano vetoch adashim, im shalem, muttar. veim chittecho, benoten taam. ushear kol hattavshil, ben shalem ben mechuttach, benoten taam. rabbi yehuda mattir betzachana, sheeno ella littol et hazzuhama:
10.2: Tappuach sherisseko unetano letoch issa, vechimmetzah, hare zo asura. seorim shennaflu letoch habbor shel mayim, af al pi shehivishu, memav muttarin:
10.3: Harode pat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yen teruma, rabbi meir oser, verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi yose mattir beshel chittim, veoser beshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot:
10.4: Tannur shehissiko vechammon shel teruma veafa vo, happat mutteret, sheen taam kammon, ella reach kammon:
10.5: Tiltan shennafla letoch habbor shel yayin, bitruma, bemaaser sheni, im yesh bazzera kede litten taam, aval lo vaetz. bishviit uvechile hakkerem vehekdesh, im yesh bazzera uvaetz kede litten taam:
10.6: Mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan bechile hakkerem, yiddaleku. hayu lo chavile tiltan shel tevel, kotesh, umechashshev kamma zera yesh bahem, umafrish et hazzera, veeno tzarich lehaferish et haetz. im hifrish, lo yomar echtosh veettol et haetz veetten et hazzera, ella noten haetz im hazzara:
10.7: Zete chullin shekkevashan im zete teruma, petzue chullin im petzue teruma, petzue chullin im sheleme teruma, o veme teruma, asur. aval sheleme chullin im petzue teruma, muttar:
10.8: Dag tame shekkevasho im dag tahor, kol garav shehu machazik satayim, im yesh bo mishkal asara zuz bihuda shehen chamesh selaim baggalil dag tame, tziro asur. rabbi yehuda omer, reviit besatayim. verabbi yose omer, echad mishshishsha asar bo:
10.9: Chagavim temeim shennichbeshu im chagavim tehorim, lo faslu et tziram. heid rabbi tzadok al tzir chagavim temeim, shehu tahor:
10.10: Kol hannichbashim ze im ze, muttarim, ella im hachasit. chasit shel chullin im chasit shel teruma, yarak shel chullin im chasit shel teruma, asur. aval chasit shel chullin im yarak shel teruma, muttar:
10.11: Rabbi yose omer, kol hannishlakim im hatteradim, asurim, mippene shehem notnin et hattaam. rabbi shimon omer, keruv shel shikya im keruv shel baal, asur, mippene shehu volea. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hammitbashshelin ze im ze, muttarim, ella im habbasar. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, hakkaved oseret veenah neeseret, mippene shehi foletet veenah bolaat:
10.12: Betza shennitbashshela bitvalin asurin, afillu chelmon shellah asur, mippene shehu volea. me shelakot ume chevashim shel teruma, asurim lezarim:

11.1: En notnin devela ugerogarot letoch hammureyas, mippene shehu meabbedan, aval notnin et hayyayin lammureyas. veen mefattemin et hashshemen, aval osin et hayyayin yenumelin. en mevashshelin yayin shel teruma, mippene shehu mamito. rabbi yehuda mattir, mippene shehu mashbicho:
11.2: Devash temarim, veyen tappuchim, vechometz sitvaniyyot, ushear kol me ferot shel teruma, rabbi eliezer mechayyev keren vechomesh, verabbi yehoshua poter. verabbi eliezer metamme mishshum mashke. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo manu chachamim shiva mashkim kemone fetamim, ella amru, shiva mashkin temeim, ushear kol hammashkin tehorin:
11.3: En osin temarim devash, velo tappuchim yayin, velo sitvaniyyot chometz, ushear kol happerot en meshannin otam mibberiyyatan bitruma uvemaaser sheni, ella zetim vaanavim bilvad. en sofgin arbaim mishshum arla, ella al hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veen meviin bikkurim mashkin, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veeno mittamme mishshum mashke, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim. veen makrivin al gabbe hammizbeach, ella hayyotze min hazzetim umin haanavim:
11.4: Uktze teenim ugerogarot, vehakkelisim vehecharuvin shel teruma, asurim lezarim:
11.5: Garine teruma, bizman shehu mechannesan, asurot, veim hishlichan, muttarot. vechen atzmot hakkadashim, bizman shehu mechannesan, asurin, veim hishlichan, muttarin. hammursan muttar. subbin shel chadashot asurot, veshel yeshanot muttarot. venoheg batteruma kederech shehu noheg bachullin. hamesallet kav o kabbayim lisa, lo yeabbed et hashshear, ella yannichennu bemakom hammutzna:
11.6: Megura sheppinna mimmenna chitte teruma, en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umelakket achat achat, ella mechabbed kedarko, venoten letochah chullin:
11.7: Vechen chavit shel shemen shennishpecha, en mechayyevin oto lihyot yoshev umetappeach, ella noheg bah kederech shehu noheg bechullin:
11.8: Hameare mikkad lechad venotef shalosh tippim, noten letochah chullin. hirkinah umitztzah, hare zo teruma. vechamma tehe vitrumat maaser shel demay veyolichenna lakkohen, echad mishshemona lashsheminit:
11.9: Karshine teruma, maachilin otam labbehema velachayya velattarnegolim. yisrael shessachar para mikkohen, maachilah karshine teruma. vechohen shessachar para miyyisrael, af al pi shemmezonoteha alav, lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. yisrael sheshsham para mikkohen, lo yaachilenna charshine teruma. vechohen sheshsham para miyyisrael, maachilah karshine teruma:
11.10: Madlikin shemen serefa bevatte chenesiyyot, uvevatte midrashot, uvammevoot haafelin, veal gabbe hacholin birshut kohen. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen, vehi lemuda etzel aviha, aviha madlik birshutah. madlikin bevet hammishte, aval lo vevet haevel, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi yose omer, bevet haevel, aval lo vevet hammishte. rabbi meir oser kan vechan. rabbi shimon mattir kan vechan:
